[SWS_DM_00357] Validity/lifetime of a Notification Request
⌈
A notifica-
tion request registered at a Uds Transport Protocol implementation according to
[SWS_DM_00356] is valid only for the next call to Start until the following call to Stop
of this Uds Transport Protocol implementation.
